_README: BLANK TEMPLATE v3 — the contract every AI fills for ONE PROJECT (destination + audience, e.g. romeforamericans). Do NOT change field NAMES or STRUCTURE; fill VALUES only. Keep every key (use null if you can't fill it). Frame everything for the audience in _meta (their passports for visa rules, their hubs for flights, their currency for money). TWO data types, reconciled differently: (1) FACTS — objective checkable values. (2) RECOMMENDATIONS — judgments with no single right answer. STATUS MODEL (set 'status' honestly per fact): 'verified' = confirmed against an OFFICIAL source (put the URL in source_url); 'agreed_stable' = a stable fact you're confident on but didn't open a source for (capital, currency code, emergency numbers); 'verify_recommended' = change-prone or high-stakes (visa rules/fees, advisories, entry rules) — flag it; 'serve_live' = volatile, must NOT be stored as a fact (exchange rate, flight prices). For RECOMMENDATIONS use rank 'core' (your strong picks) — no status needed. Return ONLY valid JSON in EXACTLY this structure. Fill EVERY section — do not skip any.

locale.money_framing: express costs in home_currency with local equivalents

_fact_field_shape: Every FACT uses: { value, source_url, status (verified|agreed_stable|verify_recommended|serve_live), notes }. For 'verified' the source_url MUST be the official page you checked. Never invent a source.

cash_vs_card.value: Cards widely accepted in cities and tourist areas, but cash is still preferred in smaller islands, tavernas, and for taxis. Always carry some euros.

tipping_norm.value: Not mandatory; 5–10% rounding up is appreciated for good service in restaurants. Check if service charge is already included.

intercity_rail.value: Limited; main line connects Athens to Thessaloniki and other northern cities. Not a primary option for island travel.

buses.value: KTEL bus network covers mainland and some regional routes; reliable and affordable.

domestic_flights.value: Available from Athens to many islands (Santorini, Mykonos, Crete, Rhodes, etc.) and Thessaloniki. Operated by Aegean, Olympic Air, Sky Express.

ride_sharing.value: Limited; Uber operates in Athens (Uber Taxi and Uber X with licensed taxis), but not widely available on islands.

car_rental_and_driving.value: Drive on the right. Americans need a valid US driver's license AND an International Driving Permit (IDP) to rent and drive legally. The IDP translates your license and is required by Greek law for non-EU drivers. Legal blood alcohol limit is 0.05%.

climate_by_season.value: Mediterranean: hot, dry summers (June–August); mild, wet winters (December–February); spring and fall are pleasant with moderate temperatures.

safety_health._note: YMYL. Advisory level is change-prone → verify_recommended. Stable items (emergency numbers) → agreed_stable.

advisory_level.value: Level 1: Exercise Normal Precautions (as of October 2025 advisory, per State Department).
advisory_level.notes: e.g. US State Dept level + date. Check for updates before travel.

main_risk.value: Petty theft and pickpocketing in crowded tourist areas, especially Athens and islands. Scams targeting tourists.

vaccines.value: No special vaccines required; routine vaccines (MMR, DPT, etc.) should be up to date.

tap_water_safe.value: Generally safe in cities and tourist centers; some islands use desalinated water which is safe but may taste different. Bottled water is widely available.

daily_budget_low.value: $80–$120 USD per person (hostel/hotel budget, street food, public transport, some sightseeing)

daily_budget_mid.value: $150–$250 USD per person (3-star hotel, taverna meals, ferry tickets, car rental share, museum entries)

daily_budget_high.value: $300–$600+ USD per person (luxury hotels, fine dining, private transfers, exclusive tours)

dress_norms.value: Casual and modest clothing is acceptable. For churches and monasteries, cover shoulders and knees. Beachwear is for beaches only.

dos_and_donts.do: Greet with a friendly 'Yassas' (hello) and 'Efharisto' (thank you).
Nodding your head up and down means 'yes'; tilting your head slightly back and up means 'no' (or a subtle upward nod).
Enjoy long, relaxed meals; taverna dining is a social experience.

dos_and_donts.dont: Don't rush service or ask for the bill immediately; it's considered rude.
Don't point with your index finger at someone; use your whole hand.

how_to_get_there.value: Fly into Athens International Airport (ATH) from US hubs. Then take Metro (Line 3), suburban rail, bus (X95), or taxi into the city. For islands, take ferry from Piraeus port (Metro Line 1) or fly domestically.

local_transport.value: Metro (Lines 1, 2, 3), buses, trams, and taxis. Metro is efficient for major sights. Buy tickets at stations or via the 'Ath.ena' app.
